      let targetHtml = null;
      let targetVersion = (versionLabel || ('OTA-' + new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-UY'))).replace(/^v/i, '');

      if (text.startsWith('{')) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
          if (parsed.version) targetVersion = String(parsed.version).replace(/^v/i, '').trim();
          if ((parsed.css || parsed.js) && !parsed.html) {
            if (parsed.css) localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_LIVE_CSS', parsed.css);
            if (parsed.js) localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_LIVE_JS', parsed.js);

              await publishGitHubRelease(text, targetVersion, releaseNotes || `Parche OTA v${targetVersion}`);
            }
            render();
            return true;
          }
          if (parsed.html && (parsed.html.includes('<!DOCTYPE html>') || parsed.html.includes('<html'))) {
            targetHtml = parsed.html;
          }
        } catch (err) {
          ui.otaStatusMsg = '❌ Error al leer el bloque JSON OTA.';
          render();
          return false;
        }
      } else if (text.includes('<!DOCTYPE html>') || text.includes('<html')) {
        targetHtml = text;
        const verMatch = text.match(/APP_BASE_VERSION\s*=\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/);
        if (!versionLabel && verMatch && verMatch[1]) targetVersion = verMatch[1].replace(/^v/i, '');
      }

      if (targetHtml) {

        localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_LAST_DATE', new Date().toLocaleString('es-UY'));

        return true;

    async function fetchPayloadForReleaseTag(repo, releaseObj) {
      const tagName = releaseObj.tag_name || (state.githubBranch || 'main');
      const filePath = (state.githubFilePath || 'ota.json').trim().replace(/^\/+/, '') || 'ota.json';
      const candidates = [filePath, 'ota.json', 'index.html'];

      for (const file of candidates) {
        try {
          const apiUrl = `https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/contents/${file}?ref=${encodeURIComponent(tagName)}&t=${Date.now()}`;
          const res = await fetch(apiUrl, { headers: getGitHubHeaders(), cache: 'no-store' });
          if (res.ok) {
            const meta = await res.json();
            if (meta && meta.content) {
              return decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(meta.content.replace(/\s/g, ''))));
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        try {
          const rawUrl = `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${repo}/${encodeURIComponent(tagName)}/${file}?t=${Date.now()}`;
          const rawRes = await fetch(rawUrl, { cache: 'no-store' });
          if (rawRes.ok) return await rawRes.text();
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      if (Array.isArray(releaseObj.assets) && releaseObj.assets.length > 0) {
        const asset = releaseObj.assets.find(a => a.name.endsWith('.json') || a.name.endsWith('.html')) || releaseObj.assets[0];
        if (asset && asset.url) {
          const assetRes = await fetch(asset.url, { headers: getGitHubHeaders('application/octet-stream'), cache: 'no-store' });
          if (assetRes.ok) return await assetRes.text();
        }
      }
      return '';
    }

      state.accounts.forEach(acc => { totalUYU += acc.currency === 'USD' ? acc.balance * rate : acc.balance; });

      return {

    function addTransaction({ title, amount, currency = 'UYU', type = 'expense', category = 'Comida y Súper', accountId = null, fromExternal = false }) {
      const numAmount = Math.abs(Number(amount) || 0);
      if (numAmount <= 0) return null;
      let targetAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === accountId) || state.accounts[0];
      if (targetAcc) {
        const delta = type === 'income' ? numAmount : -numAmount;
        if (targetAcc.currency === currency) targetAcc.balance += delta;
        else if (currency === 'USD' && targetAcc.currency === 'UYU') targetAcc.balance += delta * state.exchangeRate;
        else if (currency === 'UYU' && targetAcc.currency === 'USD') targetAcc.balance += delta / state.exchangeRate;
      }
      const now = new Date();
      const newTx = {
        id: 'tx_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
        title: (fromExternal ? '🤖 ' : '') + (title || 'Transacción'),
        amount: numAmount,
        currency,
        type,
        category,
        accountId: targetAcc ? targetAcc.id : 'acc_uyu',
        accountName: targetAcc ? targetAcc.name : 'Cuenta Principal',
        date: `${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')} ${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      };
      state.transactions.unshift(newTx);
      spawnFloatingBurst(`${type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}${formatMoney(numAmount, currency)} (${targetAcc ? targetAcc.name.split(' ')[0] : ''})`, type === 'income');
      saveState(true);

    function normalizeStr(str) {
      return String(str || '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
    }

    function findAccountMentionInText(rawText) {
      const norm = normalizeStr(rawText);
      if (!norm) return null;

      let bestAcc = null;
      let bestScore = 0;
      const ignoredWords = ['cuenta', 'mis', 'los', 'las', 'del', 'con', 'por', 'para', 'una', 'caja'];

      state.accounts.forEach(acc => {
        const accNorm = normalizeStr(acc.name);
        if (norm.includes(accNorm)) {
          if (accNorm.length + 10 > bestScore) {
            bestScore = accNorm.length + 10;
            bestAcc = acc;
          }
        }
        const tokens = accNorm.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(t => t.length >= 3 && !ignoredWords.includes(t));
        let score = 0;
        tokens.forEach(tok => {
          const regex = new RegExp(`(^|[^a-z0-9])${tok}([^a-z0-9]|$)`, 'i');
          if (regex.test(norm)) score += tok.length;
        });
        if (score > bestScore) {
          bestScore = score;
          bestAcc = acc;
        }
      });
      if (bestAcc) return bestAcc;

      const cashPatterns = /\b(efectivo|billetera|cash|contado|en mano|plata en mano|monedero)\b/i;
      if (cashPatterns.test(norm)) {
        const cashAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === 'acc_cash' || /efectivo|billetera|cash|mano|monedero/i.test(normalizeStr(a.name)));
        if (cashAcc) return cashAcc;
      }

      const usdSavingPatterns = /\b(ahorro|ahorros|cuenta dolares|cuenta en dolares|cuenta usd|ahorro dolares)\b/i;
      if (usdSavingPatterns.test(norm)) {
        const usdAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === 'acc_usd' || a.currency === 'USD' || /ahorro|dolar|usd/i.test(normalizeStr(a.name)));
        if (usdAcc) return usdAcc;
      }

      const bankDebitPatterns = /\b(brou|debito|banco|tarjeta|cuenta brou)\b/i;
      if (bankDebitPatterns.test(norm)) {
        const bankAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === 'acc_uyu' || /brou|debito|banco/i.test(normalizeStr(a.name)));
        if (bankAcc) return bankAcc;
      }

      return null;
    }

    function resolveAccountForSegment(segText, fullText, isUSD) {
      const segMatch = findAccountMentionInText(segText);

                <button onclick="ui.showExternalGeminiModal=false;render();" class="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/10 text-white font-bold text-xs">Cerrar</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ` : ''}

        ${ui.showOtaModal ? `
          <div class="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <div class="glass-97 w-full max-w-xl rounded-3xl p-6 border-2 border-cyan-400/50 animate-pop-elastic max-h-[92dvh] overflow-y-auto">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <h3 class="text-base font-extrabold text-white">🚀 Actualizador en Vivo (OTA) + GitHub Releases</h3>
                <span class="text-xs mono text-cyan-300">v${currentVer}</span>
              </div>
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-300 mb-3">Vinculado con <span class="text-cyan-300 font-bold mono">${repo}</span>. Cada actualización que instales aquí se publicará automáticamente en tus GitHub Releases.</p>

              <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-2">
                <input type="text" placeholder="R0D51/Krono-Finanzas" value="${state.githubRepo || DEFAULT_GH_REPO}" onchange="state.githubRepo=this.value.trim();saveState(false);" class="bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white mono" />
                <input type="password" placeholder="GitHub Token (ghp_...)" value="${state.githubToken || DEFAULT_GH_TOKEN}" onchange="state.githubToken=this.value.trim();saveState(false);" class="bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white mono" />
              </div>
              <input id="ota-release-notes" type="text" placeholder="Notas de la versión (Release Notes) opcionales..." value="${ui.releaseNotesInput || ''}" oninput="ui.releaseNotesInput=this.value;" class="w-full bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white mb-2" />
              <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-cyan-200 mb-3 cursor-pointer">
                <input type="checkbox" ${state.githubAutoPublishRelease ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="state.githubAutoPublishRelease=this.checked;saveState(false);" class="accent-cyan-400" />
                Publicar automáticamente como nuevo GitHub Release al instalar un código pegado
              </label>

              <textarea id="ota-paste-box" rows="5" placeholder='Pegá aquí el JSON {"version": "5.x.x", "html": "<!DOCTYPE html>..."}...' class="w-full p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 text-xs text-white mono mb-3"></textarea>
              ${ui.otaStatusMsg ? `<div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/80 border border-cyan-400/30 text-xs text-cyan-200 mb-3">${ui.otaStatusMsg}</div>` : ''}

              <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-2">
                <div class="flex gap-2">
                  <button onclick="checkGitHubReleaseOtaUpdate(true)" class="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/10 text-cyan-200 font-bold text-xs">🔄 Pull Release</button>
                  <button onclick="publishGitHubRelease()" class="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-violet-500/30 border border-violet-400/40 text-violet-200 font-bold text-xs">🏷️ Publicar Release Ahora</button>
                </div>
                <div class="flex gap-2">
                  <button onclick="ui.showOtaModal=false;render();" class="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-slate-300">Cerrar</button>
                  <button onclick="handleOtaPasteApply()" class="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 font-extrabold text-xs">Instalar OTA</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ` : ''}

        ${ui.showNewTxModal ? `
          <div class="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <form onsubmit="handleNewTxSubmit(event)" class="glass-97 w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl p-6 space-y-3 animate-pop-elastic">
              <h3 class="text-base font-extrabold text-white">➕ Registrar Movimiento</h3>
              <input id="tx-title" type="text" required placeholder="Descripción (ej: Supermercado)" class="w-full bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white" />
              <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <input id="tx-amount" type="number" step="0.01" required placeholder="Monto" class="bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white mono" />
                <select id="tx-currency" class="bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white">
                  <option value="UYU">$ UYU</option>
                  <option value="USD">US$ USD</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <select id="tx-type" class="bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white">
                  <option value="expense">Gasto (-)</option>
                  <option value="income">Ingreso (+)</option>
                </select>
                <select id="tx-account" class="bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white">
                  ${state.accounts.map(a => `<option value="${a.id}">${a.name}</option>`).join('')}
                </select>
              </div>
              <select id="tx-category" class="w-full bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white">
                ${state.budgets.map(b => `<option value="${b.name}">${b.icon} ${b.name}</option>`).join('')}
                <option value="General">📌 General</option>
                <option value="Ingreso">💰 Ingreso</option>
              </select>
              <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
                <button type="button" onclick="ui.showNewTxModal=false;render();" class="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-slate-300">Cancelar</button>
                <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 font-extrabold text-xs">Guardar</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        ` : ''}

        ${ui.showNewAccountModal ? `
          <div class="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <form onsubmit="createAccount(event)" class="glass-97 w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl p-6 space-y-3 animate-pop-elastic">
              <h3 class="text-base font-extrabold text-white">🏦 Crear Nueva Cuenta</h3>
              <input id="acc-name" type="text" required placeholder="Nombre (ej: Itaú Dólares)" class="w-full bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white" />
              <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                <select id="acc-currency" class="bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-xs text-white">
                  <option value="UYU">$ UYU</option>
                  <option value="USD">US$ USD</option>
                </select>
                <input id="acc-balance" type="number" step="0.01" placeholder="Saldo inicial" class="bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-xs text-white mono" />
                <input id="acc-icon" type="text" placeholder="Ícono 🏦" value="🏦" class="bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-xs text-white text-center" />
              </div>
              <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
                <button type="button" onclick="ui.showNewAccountModal=false;render();" class="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-slate-300">Cancelar</button>
                <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 font-extrabold text-xs">Crear Cuenta</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        ` : ''}

        ${ui.showTransferModal ? `
          <div class="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <form onsubmit="handleTransferSubmit(event)" class="glass-97 w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl p-6 space-y-3 animate-pop-elastic">
              <h3 class="text-base font-extrabold text-white">⇄ Transferir entre Cuentas</h3>
              <div>
                <label class="text-[11px] text-slate-300">Desde Cuenta Origen</label>
                <select id="tr-from" class="w-full bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white mt-1">
                  ${state.accounts.map(a => `<option value="${a.id}">${a.name} (${formatMoney(a.balance, a.currency)})</option>`).join('')}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label class="text-[11px] text-slate-300">Hacia Cuenta Destino</label>
                <select id="tr-to" class="w-full bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white mt-1">
                  ${state.accounts.map((a, i) => `<option value="${a.id}" ${i===1?'selected':''}>${a.name} (${a.currency})</option>`).join('')}
                </select>
              </div>
              <input id="tr-amount" type="number" step="0.01" required placeholder="Monto en moneda de origen" class="w-full bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white mono" />
              <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
                <button type="button" onclick="ui.showTransferModal=false;render();" class="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-slate-300">Cancelar</button>
                <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 font-extrabold text-xs">Transferir</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        ` : ''}

        ${ui.showNewBudgetModal ? `
          <div class="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <form onsubmit="handleCreateBudgetSubmit(event)" class="glass-97 w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl p-6 space-y-3 animate-pop-elastic">
              <h3 class="text-base font-extrabold text-white">🎯 Nueva Categoría de Presupuesto</h3>
              <input id="bg-name" type="text" required placeholder="Nombre (ej: Salidas y Ocio)" class="w-full bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white" />
              <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <input id="bg-limit" type="number" required placeholder="Tope mensual ($ UYU)" class="bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white mono" />
                <input id="bg-icon" type="text" placeholder="Ícono 🎯" value="🎯" class="bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white text-center" />
              </div>
              <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
                <button type="button" onclick="ui.showNewBudgetModal=false;render();" class="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-slate-300">Cancelar</button>
                <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 font-extrabold text-xs">Crear</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        ` : ''}

        ${ui.showVoiceWidgetOverlay ? `
          <div class="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center">
            <div class="glass-97 w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl p-8 border-2 border-cyan-400/50 animate-pop-elastic">
              <div class="text-4xl mb-3">${ui.isListening ? '🎙️' : '✨'}</div>
              <h3 class="text-lg font-extrabold text-white mb-1">${ui.isListening ? 'Gemini te está escuchando...' : 'Asistente de Voz Krono'}</h3>
              <p class="text-xs text-cyan-200 mono min-h-[2rem] my-3">${ui.voiceTranscript || 'Decí por ejemplo: "Gasté 850 en súper con efectivo y 1200 de luz con débito"'}</p>
              <div class="mb-4">
                <select onchange="ui.voiceTargetAccountId=this.value;" class="bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-cyan-200 font-bold">
                  <option value="auto" ${ui.voiceTargetAccountId === 'auto' ? 'selected' : ''}>🤖 Cuenta: Auto-detectar por voz</option>
                  ${state.accounts.map(a => `<option value="${a.id}" ${ui.voiceTargetAccountId === a.id ? 'selected' : ''}>${a.icon || '🏦'} Forzar: ${a.name}</option>`).join('')}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div class="flex justify-center gap-3 mt-2">
                <button onclick="${ui.isListening ? 'stopVoiceCapture()' : 'startVoiceCapture()'}" class="spring-btn px-5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 font-extrabold text-xs">
                  ${ui.isListening ? 'Detener y Procesar' : 'Hablar Ahora'}
                </button>
                <button onclick="stopVoiceCapture();ui.showVoiceWidgetOverlay=false;render();" class="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/10 text-slate-300 text-xs">Cerrar</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ` : ''}
      `;
    }
  </script>
</body></html>
